name: Napalm's debuff text states the per-stack increase the client data omits
contract: Napalm 805315 is the Tinker debuff applied by direct Fire damage. Its client
Spell.dbc text says Fire damage taken 'is increased' with no amount and no
per-stack statement. The server adds +3% Fire damage taken per stack (Effect 0
base points 2, read by the scaling script) up to 10 stacks over 8 s, with a
flat -3% healing received. The fix publishes the corrected Description and
ToolTip through coa_client_spell_description, streamed as SMSG_PATCH_SPELL
(opcode 2346) at login. This scenario reads the streamed rows: row 500639
(Runeshroud) is the control proving the stream is alive, and row 805315 must
arrive with the per-stack line in both columns.

steps.label: Let spawn AI, level scaling and the login patch stream settle
